safe_description: Monthly cloud and AI service category by cost band, environment and product tag; no account secrets or patient identifiers
not_allowed_data: credentials; tokens; raw invoices with sensitive identifiers; PHI/ePHI; payer/claims/EHR data
human_review_trigger: cost owner missing or cost spike unexplained

safe_description: Question ID, topic label, current answer source, answer owner and evidence age
not_allowed_data: unapproved legal answer; raw audit package; secrets; certification claim outside scoped evidence
human_review_trigger: answer older than 90 days or no approved owner

safe_description: Vendor/model category, data category, BAA/subprocessor status label and owner note
not_allowed_data: vendor credentials; contract PDFs not approved for sharing; PHI/ePHI; patient data

safe_description: Workflow category, data category, model/vendor category, human-review trigger and escalation owner
not_allowed_data: patient narratives; diagnosis/treatment details; payer records; claims records; EHR export
human_review_trigger: clinical, billing, legal, privacy or safety decision involved

safe_description: Trust-center URL, control topic, owner and last reviewed date approved for diagnostic use
not_allowed_data: private audit evidence; SOC 2 report without authorization; secrets; customer-specific docs
human_review_trigger: evidence source unavailable or not approved for external use

safe_description: Queue category, escalation SLA, owner role and review-status counts without individual records
not_allowed_data: call transcripts; support tickets with PHI/ePHI; patient names; payer identifiers
human_review_trigger: human-review backlog unowned or unsafe automation proposed
claim_boundary: no staffing, patient outcome or compliance claim
